name: SaaS License Compliance Audit
objective: Parse incoming software publisher usage demands, deployed seat counts, unassigned licenses, and financial risk metrics.

attributes.name: Software Publisher
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the software publisher / vendor name.

attributes.name: Licenses Purchased
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the number of licenses/seats purchased.

attributes.name: Licenses Deployed
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the number of deployed/used seats.

attributes.name: Unassigned Licenses
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the count of unassigned/unused licenses.

attributes.name: Over-Deployment Count
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the number of seats over the entitlement, if any.

attributes.name: Financial Risk Exposure
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the estimated financial penalty/true-up exposure.
